title: A small JavaScript ordinary-MP4-to-MSE adapter

definition.title: A small JavaScript ordinary-MP4-to-MSE adapter
definition.source_excerpt: New deployment/packaging candidate · P1 · PROPOSED / NOT TESTED Extends: R06, R09. Reference primitives: S2, S3, S10. Question. Can a tightly scoped MP4 preparation route avoid downloading or compiling a Wasm muxer when controlled MSE playback is needed? Mechanism. Parse the selected ordinary-MP4 sample tables in JavaScript and construct small fMP4 headers around the unchanged compressed samples. This differs from R09, which only forwards media that is already fragmented. Smallest useful experiment. Start with unencrypted, fixed-configuration H.264/AAC MP4: one video and one selected audio track. Support the fixture’s actual timing/priming or reject it. Compare output with host-FFmpeg packet-copy fragmentation, then add B-frame composition offsets, a tail moov and malformed-size controls. Do not expand into a general demuxer.
